runtimeState.reason: R1368 uses the already-qualified live promotion/media runtime; this successor changes Local public/member workflow surfaces and does not fork runtime behavior.

materialChanges: Post-payment/member-account path prioritizes completing the member profile, profile media, business information, promotions/events and public preview.
Member first-value page now provides a direct ordered setup path instead of generic activation language.
Resident-facing preview added for coupon, special, sale, promotion and event drafts before publication.
Authenticated preview controls added for attached promotional image/PDF media.
Business-facing remove and replace controls added for promotion media using existing qualified ownership and active-membership runtime gates.
Dynamic English/Spanish labels added for the new preview and media-management controls.
Free claim, factual correction, removal and legitimate basic management remain explicitly separate from optional $35/year Community Membership.
No guaranteed traffic, ranking, leads, customers, sales, bookings or revenue claims were introduced.

knownBlockers: Fresh SRE evidence still requires repair or replacement of invalid prepared outreach profile URLs before those candidates can be certified.
Fresh Zoho sender/authentication, suppression, organization/domain, prior-outcome and provider checks remain mandatory at point of send.
SCC exact artifact/currentness acceptance remains independently owned.
